coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 9 ground-truth variable items: the three required LLaMA-2 sizes, weight precisions, four core methods, WikiText-2 evaluation at sequence length 2048, perplexity, and Inf/NaN stability detection.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The three remaining constants are not faithfully fixed: activations may use BF16 and KV-cache precision is unspecified; quantization varies between symmetric/asymmetric and channel/group schemes instead of fixed per-column asymmetric quantization; and the baseline allows BF16 rather than strictly FP16. Additional models, datasets, methods, and metrics unnecessarily expand the target experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth results.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the QuaRot-GPTQ improvements at 2–3 bits, low-precision RTN failures, partial stabilization of RTN, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
